description: Fixture: table S(ID LONG primary key, T TEXT(255), M MEMO) with the R-STRING-1 rows stored through a DAO table-type recordset AddNew/Value/Update; then, through ADODB.Connection with the ACE provider, table C with T TEXT(255) WITH COMPRESSION and M MEMO WITH COMPRESSION created by Execute and the same rows stored through an ADO keyset recordset AddNew/Value/Update. Created in ACCDB by DBEngine.CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, 128); every call's result is recorded and the closed file is kept.

args.text: CREATE TABLE S (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_S PRIMARY KEY, T TEXT(255), M MEMO)
CREATE TABLE C (ID LONG CONSTRAINT PK_C PRIMARY KEY, T TEXT(255) WITH COMPRESSION, M MEMO WITH COMPRESSION)
